CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Regency is North Penajam Paser Utara Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region of North Penajam Paser Utara Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of North Penajam Paser Utara.
4. Village is a legal community unit that has territorial boundaries authorized to regulate and manage government affairs, the interests of the local community based on community initiative, rights of origin and/or traditional rights that are recognized and respected in the government system of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia.
5. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral lines up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman.
6. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
-3-
7. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
8. Prevention is any action or effort made to eliminate various factors that cause acts of violence against women.
9. Woman is an adult human of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
10. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.
11. Violence Against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
12. Victim is a Woman who experiences acts of violence.
13. Health Rehabilitation is the recovery of Victims of human trafficking from health disorders they suffer.
14. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
15. Repatriation is an effort to return Female Victims of Violence to the Family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.
16. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with the Family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for Victims.
17. Legal Aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or Victims of Violence against Women and children that are gender sensitive.
18. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA, is a regional technical implementation unit established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
19. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to Victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
-4-

CHAPTER III
AUTHORITY AND RESPONSIBILITY
Article 4
(1) The Regional Government has the authority and responsibility for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.
(2) The authority as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. service activities for Women Victims of Violence; b. monitoring and strengthening for victims of Violence; and
c. improving the capabilities of officials and other stakeholders.

CHAPTER VII
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 12
(1) Regional Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.
(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence in the Region.

CHAPTER X
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 18
(1) In providing Protection to Women Victims of Violence, the community may:
a. form Family partners at the kelurahan/Village level;
b. form Women's Protection units within community organizations;
c. conduct socialization of Women's rights independently;
d. provide first aid to Victims; and
e. report to the competent agency/authority if Violence against Victims occurs in their environment.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

Letter a Sufficiently clear.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c Sufficiently clear.
Letter d What is meant by Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the purpose of strengthening the self of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.

Article 13
(1) Monitoring is conducted through coordination and direct monitoring of related Regional Government agencies on a regular basis.
(2) Monitoring is carried out from the planning stage up to the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence for the current year.

Article 14
(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of Women is carried out at the end of each fiscal year or if needed according to requirements.
(2) The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women for the following year.
(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER IX
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 16
(1) The Regent conducts guidance on the development of UPTD PPA. (2) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. provision of implementation instructions;
b. mentoring;
c. supervision; and
d. monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of Services for Women Victims of Violence, for officials as well as the community.

CHAPTER VIII
REPORTING
Article 15
(1) The Regent is responsible for preparing a report on the implementation of SPM in the field of integrated services for Women Victims of Violence and submitting it to the Governor, with copies submitted to the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection and the Minister of Home Affairs.
(2) Reporting on implementation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted annually.
(3) Further provisions regarding the procedures and form of reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 17
The Regent conducts guidance and supervision over the implementation of MSS in the field of integrated services for Women Victims of Violence in the Region.

CHAPTER XI
FUNDING
Article 19
Funding in the implementation of Protection for Women Victims of Violence, is sourced from:
a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and
b. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VI
SOCIAL PROTECTION HOUSE
Article 11
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to establish a social protection house and/or Safe House or other designation.
(2) The social protection house and/or Safe House as referred to in paragraph (1) guarantees the implementation of Health Rehabilitation Services, Social Rehabilitation, Return, and Social Reintegration.
(3) For the implementation of Services as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Government may utilize social protection houses and/or Safe Houses owned by the community or other social service institutions.

Article 6
(1) UPID PPA services include:
a. providing Services and handling as quickly as possible for Victims;
b. providing ease, comfort, safety, and free of charge for Victims;
c. maintaining the confidentiality of Victims; and
d. guaranteeing justice and legal certainty for Victims.
(2) Further provisions regarding the procedures for UPID PPA Services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by the Regent's Regulation.

CONCERNING
THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE BY THE GRACE OF GOD THE ALMIGHTY

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

(2) Reporting on implementation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted annually.
(3) Further provisions regarding the procedures and form of reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

c. improving the capabilities of officials and other stakeholders.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

(3) Further provisions regarding the procedures and form of reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

d. provide first aid to Victims; and
e. report to the competent agency/authority if Violence against Victims occurs in their environment.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

ABOUT
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the basic rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, upheld, and the dignity of humanity enhanced without discrimination, and welfare and justice for Women should be improved.
Violence is any unlawful act, with or without using means, against the physical and psychological integrity that causes danger to life or the body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

CHAPTER VI
SOCIAL PROTECTION HOUSE
Article 11
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to establish a social protection house and/or Safe House or other designation.
(2) The social protection house and/or Safe House as referred to in paragraph (1) guarantees the implementation of Health Rehabilitation Services, Social Rehabilitation, Return, and Social Reintegration.
(3) For the implementation of Services as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Government may utilize social protection houses and/or Safe Houses owned by the community or other social service institutions.

CHAPTER III
AUTHORITY AND RESPONSIBILITY
Article 4
(1) The Regional Government has the authority and responsibility for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.
(2) The authority as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. service activities for Women Victims of Violence; b. monitoring and strengthening for victims of Violence; and
c. improving the capabilities of officials and other stakeholders.

CHAPTER VII
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 12
(1) Regional Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.
(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence in the Region.

Article 13
(1) Monitoring is conducted through coordination and direct monitoring of related Regional Government agencies on a regular basis.
(2) Monitoring is carried out from the planning stage up to the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence for the current year.

CHAPTER X
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 18
(1) In providing Protection to Women Victims of Violence, the community may:
a. form Family partners at the kelurahan/Village level;
b. form Women's Protection units within community organizations;
c. conduct socialization of Women's rights independently;
d. provide first aid to Victims; and
e. report to the competent agency/authority if Violence against Victims occurs in their environment.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.
